title: At the hairdresser's
instructions: Lisa kuaförde saçını kestiriyor. Kısa bir diyalog; ne istediğine dikkat et.

script.speaker: lisa
script.text: Just a little shorter, please. About two centimetres.

script.speaker: hair
script.text: Would you like a different colour too?

script.speaker: lisa
script.text: No, thanks. I like my colour. Just a cut and a wash.

script.speaker: hair
script.text: No problem. That takes about forty minutes.
